description: This Java source file defines the TreeFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing ModelTree objects from XML resources within the OFBiz widget framework.

classes.name: TreeFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and caching ModelTree instances from XML resources.

methods.name: getTreeFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelTree object from a specified resource location and tree name, loading and caching the XML document if necessary.

methods.name: readTreeDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to construct a map of ModelTree objects keyed by their names.
